_readme: Dual review record for the forest-env kit. score/status = primary verdict; kimi = independent kimi-k2.8 dual review (A: structure, B: dressing). agreement: confirm = same status, drift1 = score delta 1, flag-resolved = delta >= 2 fixed and verified. r2 edits this session: bramble density, tree-stump mushroom recolor, campfire flame saturation.

ancient-oak.notes: Hero clumped canopy and root-flared trunk read as THE old tree at 128 px; palette on contract. Nit: one-sided buttress flare vs the 4-6 roots specced. USER FLAG FIX r2: rotateY units bug had stacked all 6 buttress fins on one azimuth - fixed; trunk widened to 1.55 m at base, crown to 11 clumps over 5 m. Now dwarfs the common oak. FIXED post-review nit (both kimis): warm flare halved, trunk reads bark-brown not cut-wood. Verified in render.

campfire.notes: Stone ring, charred log tips, teardrop flame all read; on contract. Flame washed pale in fast preview (vertex-color interpolation); r2 raised emissive to 3 and cut the hot-core mix to 0.45. Verify in the textured scene render.

kimi.notes: Flame emissive renders pale peach instead of #ff9a3c; warm focal accent weaker than specified.

fallen-log.notes: Exact spec: hollow end with pale cut ring, growth rings on the back face, bark grooves, shelf mushrooms, moss patches. Best of the batch.

kimi.notes: Reads as a mossy hollow log at 128 px; top stubs slightly peg-like.

tree-stump.notes: r2 FIXED: trial build had salmon-red mushroom caps (#d9483b) off-palette; recolored to pale #c9a06a. Growth rings and root flares read well.

kimi.notes: Salmon-red blob off-palette but does not break the style.

fern.notes: Arching fiddlehead fronds with striped leaflets read as fern at 128 px. Nits: fronds tubular rather than leafy, greens a touch bright.

kimi.notes: Greens brighter than the #2f7a3f/#4a9a4f contract; intent clear.

bramble.notes: r2 FIXED after the batch's only FLAG (delta 3): kimi-B was right that r1 read as a sparse young shrub. r2 weaves 16 canes (8 spray + 6 crossing + 2 heart), 6 thorns per cane, denser mid-cane leaves, fuller mound. Verified: reads as an impassable thicket from all four views.

kimi.notes: (r1) Sparse young shrub, not a thorny tangle; needs denser interwoven canes, more thorns, darker body.

forest-ground.notes: r2 deepseek: even leaf scatter with twigs, no edge clustering. Nit: base green runs sunny rather than the shaded #4a8a3f spec; verify it differentiates from grass-ground in the map.

dead-tree.notes: r2 deepseek: gnarled bare snag, 4-5 forks with pale cut tips, root flare, moss patch on the shaded side. Reads instantly as the mood accent. FIXED post-review: bark damped into #8a5a35/#5f3d22, sky-bleach and ridge light reduced, neon moss muted to #57a05b. Verified in render.

footpath-corner.notes: r2 glm: clean 90-degree bend, path meets the tile edges at midpoints, pebble specks. Tiles with the straight pending its re-run. USER FLAG FIX: shoulders re-styled to forest-ground (shaded #4a8a3f, litter specks, 7 leaf blobs); fix verified in main-repo render. FIXED post-review: same shoulder tuning as the straight. Verified in render.

tall-grass.notes: r2 mimo: arching blades with 4 wheat seed heads, matches the mockup tufts. Softer than bramble, wilder than lawn - right slot.

rock-cluster.notes: r2 muse: 5-6 varied gray stones, one moss cap, dirt mound. Nit: stones very smooth (soapy); reads fine at map scale. FIXED post-review: sandy disc recolored to shaded floor #4a8a3f family with leaf flecks, disc shrunk, moss reduced to the single spec cap. Verified in render.

reeds.notes: r2 muse: 3 cattail heads on stalks plus upright blades from a mud mound. Reads as stream-bank reeds instantly.

footpath-straight.notes: r2 glm: clean straight trail, meets both edges at midpoints, pebbles. User flag: shoulders were sunny lawn - harmonized to forest-ground styling (shaded #4a8a3f base, litter specks, 6 leaf blobs). Fix verified in main-repo render. FIXED post-review: moss-pocket term added, sun dapples 0.55->0.40, litter 0.30->0.35 - now forest-ground average. Verified in render.

mushroom.notes: r2 mimo: 5-6 tan and brown caps with pale stems on a mossy deep-green mound (#2c6f38 family - already shaded, no ground-color issue). Matches the mockup clusters.

campfire-out.notes: r2 glm: stone ring, white-gray ash bed, charred black-brown logs. Reads instantly as the lit campfire burned out - the requested two-state pair works.
